name: windows-update-search
title: Check for Windows updates
description: Searches for updates that are not installed, with the Windows Update Agent (search only: it downloads and installs nothing). Lists their titles. Uses WSUS when the computer is set to.
fixes: ^Updates: No Windows update installed for \d+ days
measure: Add-ArhInfo 'Update source' $(if ($wu -and $wu.WUServer -and $au -and $au.UseWUServer -eq 1) { "WSUS $($wu.WUServer)" } elseif ($wu -and $wu.WUServer) { "Windows Update (WSUS $($wu.WUServer) is set but not in use)" } else { 'Windows Update' })
